All done. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:**
1. Investigated deployment history — v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions. First attempt hit an orchestrator error and only completed us-east, so I retried and us-west and eu-west completed successfully.
3. Verified health: checkout-api is now healthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.0, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** The incident creation call timed out, so I verified via `list_incidents` rather than retrying blindly — the incident did go through successfully:
- **INC-0001** (SEV2, open) — "checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures - rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary of the failure, the rollback steps, and the partial-failure retry.
